name: Embryonic Stem Cell Research
overview: Scripture reveals that human life is uniquely created by God in His image, entrusted with dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:26), and protected by the commandment against killing (Exodus 20:13). From conception, life is sacred and purposefully formed, as seen in the calling of the Nazirite from the womb (Judges 13:7) and the intimate crafting of the individual by God's hands (Job 10:8; Psalms 139:13). The mystery of life’s formation in the womb underscores God’s sovereign work in creation (Ecclesiastes 11:5), affirming the sanctity and divine origin of embryonic life that must be honored in all considerations, including scientific research.
